name: criminal-ip
label: Criminal IP
description: Criminal IP provides cyber threat intelligence search engine through which you can scan IP, domain, urls.

fields.name: server_url
fields.title: Server URL
fields.tooltip: Specify the server url to which you want to connect and perform automated information.
fields.description: Specify the server url to which you want to connect and perform automated information.

fields.name: api_key
fields.title: API Key
fields.tooltip: Specify the Criminal IP API Key through which you will connect and perform actions.
fields.description: Specify the Criminal IP API Key through which you will connect and perform actions.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.
fields.name: verify_ssl

operations.title: Get URL Reputation
operations.description: Uploads a URL to Criminal IP and retrieves the analysis results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.title: URL
parameters.description: Specify the URL to retrieve its reputation information from Criminal IP.

operations.title: Get IP Reputation
operations.description: Uploads a IP to Criminal IP and retrieves the analysis results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.title: IP
parameters.description: Specify the IP address to retrieve its reputation information from Criminal IP.

operations.title: Get Domain Reputation
operations.description: Uploads a domain to Criminal IP and retrieves the analysis results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.title: Domain
parameters.description: Specify the domain to retrieve its reputation information from Criminal IP.

operations.title: Asset Search
operations.description: Search for assets in Criminal IP database.

parameters.name: query
parameters.title: Query
parameters.description: Specify the search query for assets in Criminal IP database.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.title: Offset
parameters.tooltip: Specify the offset for pagination (optional, default: 0).
parameters.description: Returns 10 data entries per call. Input must be a multiple of 10.
